meta.what: camfix19 rig: 2.5D pre-rendered frames. Idle = real frames of one generated head-turn video (rest 0-7 = big open happy smile, the IMG_3647 look; turn 8-47 = turn to her left up to yaw ~-0.5). Blink and talk frames are composites: the rest frame itself, with only the eye area (blink) or only the mouth/jaw area (talk) taken from other generated frames, aligned and feathered.
